item.title: ABC News: Euphoria turns to raw fear on Wall Street
item.description: Wall Street indices nosedive as investor thinking about the rollout of AI infrastructure turns on its head. So, is this latest sell-off a flash in the plan or the start of a broader bear market?

item.title: ABC News: Socceroos still waiting for World Cup payment from FA
item.description: Socceroos players who competed at this year's World Cup are yet to be paid their match fees, three months after the tournament's conclusion.

item.title: ABC News: Police offer $250k reward to find offshore crime boss
item.description: Police describe Anthony Pele as one of their highest-priority fugitives, offering $250,000 to associates willing to turn the alleged gang leader over to authorities.

item.title: ABC News: Teenager found guilty of raping woman during home invasion
item.description: A court heard the boy held the woman's partner at knifepoint while she was raped by two other teenagers.

item.title: ABC News: Aussie Rules has long history of footy gimmicks gone wrong
item.description: Forget Wharfie Time. Australian Rules football has a long history of gimmicks that haven't always turned out well, and they have involved everything from a hovercraft to a Batmobile and even an elephant.

item.title: ABC News: SA Australians of the Year named as outgoing winner wants space travel 'reframed'
item.description: An endo-gynaecologist specialising in pelvic floor treatments has been named the South Australia's 2027 Australian of the Year in a ceremony where the former recipient doubled down on her wish to secure a spot on a future space mission.

item.title: ABC News: Fake robbery of autistic boy online leads to scam warning
item.description: Greg Sealey called for help online after claiming his autistic son was robbed, but police say it didn't happen — it was a scam.

item.title: ABC News: Live: Beau Lamarre-Condon back in witness box in double murder trial
item.description: Beau Lamarre-Condon is continuing evidence in his double murder trial. Follow live.

item.title: ABC News: NT architect wins top honour, joining ranks of Sydney Opera House designer
item.description: The Alice Springs architect behind the NT's only 6-star green rated building has been awarded the industry's highest honour. The win sees Susan Dugdale join the ranks of other influential designers, including the architect behind the Sydney Opera House.

item.title: ABC News: Researchers call for rethink on disposal of washed-up whale carcasses
item.description: Marine scientist Olaf Meynecke says disposing of dead whales is complex, costly and should not fall to local councils.

item.title: ABC News: Child dies, woman in serious condition after two-car Bass Highway crash
item.description: A 10-year-old girl has died and a woman is in a serious condition in hospital after a two-car crash near Somerset in Tasmania's north-west.

item.title: ABC News: Police divers and helicopters search for missing fisherman
item.description: Police from Victoria and New South Wales are searching for a man who disappeared after going fishing near the Murray River

item.title: ABC News: Brothers open Ceduna's first barber shop in 50 years
item.description: Two Eyre Peninsula brothers have opened a 100 per cent Aboriginal-owned barber shop in the main street of Ceduna, the first men's hairdresser in the town for 50 years.

item.title: ABC News: Police expand operation targeting Melbourne arsons and extortion
item.description: Night-time patrols as part of Operation Phoenix will be expanded across Melbourne as police try to stem a wave of arson attacks and extortion linked to crime gangs.

item.title: ABC News: WA quick Lance 'Wild Thing' Morris hopes to be even faster after surgery
item.description: After years of back issues, cricketer Lance Morris is finally fit and firing, and the Western Australian is keen to put his name in the frame for a Test call up once again.

item.title: ABC News: Council clears 40,000kg of dead carp from creek
item.description: Authorities say low oxygen levels killed thousands of the pest species.
